title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. translated_title: 面向搜索增强语言模型的基于证据的信用分配方法
translated_abstract: 基于终端答案奖励的强化学习使搜索增强语言模型能够在无需步骤级标注的情况下交替进行推理与检索，然而结果监督会为轨迹中的每一次搜索分配相同的信用，而不论其是否检索到了有用的信息。这一局限在某个问题的所有采样 rollout 均失败时尤为严重——即使各轨迹收集到的证据差异显著，以组为中心的结果优势也会坍缩为零。我们提出了基于证据的信用分配方法，它通过一个仅用于训练的辅助信号来增强终端结果奖励，该信号衡量检索到的文档对参考答案似然性的提升程度。ECA 并非对完整的对话前缀进行评分，而是在仅包含问题和迄今观察到的去重文档的纯证据提示下查询当前策略的冻结快照，从而隔离出所检索段落的效用。
tldr: 提出基于证据的信用分配方法（ECA），通过衡量检索文档对参考答案似然性的提升作为辅助训练信号，解决搜索增强语言模型强化学习中对每次搜索给予相同信用的粗粒度监督问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which supplements terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve reference-answer likelihood, addressing the coarse outcome supervision that assigns identical credit to every search in search-augmented language models.
